svg.title: Nitration of benzene event 1
svg.desc: HNO₃ + H₂SO₄ ⇌ H₂NO₃⁺ + HSO₄⁻ Nitric acid hydroxyl O → sulfuric acid H; acid O–H pair → acid O. Formal N+/O− charges preserve octets.

g.text: Nitric acid hydroxyl O → sulfuric acid H; acid O–H pair → acid O. Formal N+/O− charges preserve octets.
Original structural mechanism · 2-electron curved arrows · 2D depiction, not a calculated trajectory.
